items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: And there was Rick Holmes who was a disc jockey in L.A. And he did narrations and we did music for each of the signs.

ctx.x: Yeah, exactly. And there was Rick Holmes who was a disc jockey in L.A. And he did narrations and we did music for each of the signs. I don’t know what happened with that. Cannonball had a T.V. show. A talk show.
Yeah. I’d love to see that.
